Identity: cursor-grok-4.6-help. SLICE A CANDIDATE + PROBE SHAPE FOR B–D.

Bead: bd-01M16X7E6ZRPTCAJ9YEJY9EFCB
Reservation: rv-01M16X7MWPMHEQEKJ8AERV2WMT
Branch: slice-a-gold-unforgeable
Candidate: 96a7963c474ea7f5c7fe4b6d831b50a2b996ae73
Parent: 97f53a28bf1131862dbfdf885876c70fa18da5a2 (on main)
Ancestry: parent is an ancestor of main; candidate is not.

WHAT CHANGED
Gold is no longer a public case class. final class Gold private (val byUnit),
structural equals/hashCode, intentional toString. validated is the only
construction path (new Gold(...)). GoldUnit / GoldTarget stay case classes.

FORGE FIRST (capacity to fail)
GoldForgeSuite, outside storymodel4s.bench, unpiped embedBench/testOnly:
GATE_EXIT=0, Passed: Total 2.
validated(Vector(distorted), emptyView) = Left(DistortedWithoutAnchor)
AND Gold.fromProduct(Tuple1(Map(unit -> distorted))) minted that map.
Suite deleted after the door closed.

GATE (unpiped, isolated -Dsbt.boot.directory=/tmp/sbt-boot-slice-a)
embedBench/clean then embedBench/testOnly ConstructionProbeSuite:
  GATE_EXIT=0, Passed: Total 5. Clean recompile stated.
embedBench/test: GATE_EXIT=0, Passed: Total 63.
embedBench/scalafmtCheck: success, 8 sources.
compileAll: GATE_EXIT=0.
Reference-scope: Gold lives only in embed-bench (JVM-only). No other module
imports the type. storyatlas seam does not consume embed-bench.

PROBE SHAPE — copy this (file:
embed-bench/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/benchprobe/ConstructionProbeSuite.scala)

Package: a *probe* package OUTSIDE the defining package
(storymodel4s.benchprobe, not storymodel4s.bench). A same-package probe
cannot fail on private access and cannot tell a closed door from an open one.

Assert, in this order:
1. Same-shape positive control. typeCheckErrors on fromProduct of a
   remaining public case class in the same module is EMPTY. Here:
   GoldUnit.fromProduct((id, Vector.empty, None, Set.empty, Groundedness,
   None, DiscourseFunction, false)). If this control fails, every refusal
   beside it is meaningless (rule: negative compile-time assertion needs a
   positive control).
2. fromProduct refused: typeCheckErrors("T.fromProduct(...)") nonEmpty.
3. copy refused: typeCheckErrors("(x: T) => x.copy(...)") nonEmpty.
4. Public reads still typecheck (accessors, lookup).
5. Smart constructor still typechecks AND still rejects the invalid state
   at runtime (here DistortedWithoutAnchor). Closing the door must not
   delete the check.

How the probe can fail (either satisfies rule 4):
- Same-shape control, used here: GoldUnit is still a case class, so
  fromProduct still exists. If the control snippet fails to compile, the
  refusals are vacated.
- Mutation kill alternative: restore `final case class`, clean-recompile,
  watch tests 2–3 go red. Not required when the control is present.

Do NOT use assert(!typeChecks(...)) without reading the error. Use
typeCheckErrors. Compile-time probes need a clean recompile of the module
(Zinc can reuse stale test bytecode across case→non-case).

Sub-shape (b) like Gold: smart constructor already exists; only close the
case-class doors. Sub-shape (a) like TranscriptAtlas: you must BUILD the
construction path, not just close the old one — this probe shape still
applies after that path exists.

Ready for chief gate / ack. scout may copy the probe now.
